summary: P2 (guidance render-from-module) Core foundation — collapse the duplicate Core guidance builders onto the canonical module generators (shipped in P0/P1.4a). This is the GUIDANCE side (what the authoring agent SEES) — the gates are already byte-identical from P1, so this changes only the rendered guidance, NOT gate behavior. P2.1 collapse the two parallel submissionSpec builders: MissionBriefingBuilder.ts (around lines 311-331, enrichDimensionTask.submissionSpec) AND DimensionCatalogPayload.ts (around lines 178-196, the second parallel buildSubmissionSpec) both call the module buildSubmissionSpec(dim) from @alembic/core/knowledge. This resolves the long-standing 0-vs-3 target-count contradiction (MissionBriefingBuilder 最少3条 vs DimensionCatalogPayload 可以提交0条) in one place. Per controller decision D-B: pick the evidence-consistent floor of >=3 for rule/pattern in the module (consistent with the host-agent path, single source of truth) — this is an INTENTIONAL visible-guidance change to alembic_plan (the draft no longer says 0 candidates is OK); verify plan-tool.ts (around line 417, the DimensionCatalogPayload consumer) still type-checks against the unified buildSubmissionSpec shape (the two old builders returned different field wording crossDimensionDedup/contentQuality — reconcile so the consumer compiles). P2.4 collapse the two checklists: DimensionSop.ts PRE_SUBMIT_CHECKLIST (around 1702-1739) AND SHARED_SUBMIT_CHECKLIST (around 53-59) both call the module buildPreSubmitChecklist() — one checklist, one FAIL_EXAMPLES set (stop the MissionBriefingSupport FAIL_EXAMPLES delete-on-compaction loss). Both generators read the same gateRules() table, so the rendered guidance now states the actual rules (the 45-verb allowlist, the contrast-marker rule, the >=3 distinct-files floor and its scope-escape, markdown floor) — guidance==gate by construction. Acceptance on node 22: Core build:check green; Core test green incl the briefing tests (both submissionSpec builders collapsed; checklists collapsed); a test or grep proof that the rendered submissionSpec now states >=3 and lists the real allowlisted verbs; plan-tool.ts type-checks. The 3 pre-existing lint:naming files are the out-of-scope carve-out — do not touch; use build:check + test as the green bar. Discipline: GUIDANCE-only change (gates untouched, byte-identical from P1); D-B is the one INTENTIONAL alembic_plan visible-guidance change (>=3 floor); main only, no push or tag or version bump; FieldSpec unchanged; do not relax any gate. Producer-consumer: Core consumes its own module generators; the Plugin cold-start render + example injection + OnboardingContract + the section 13.L front-load, and the main-body/Plugin tool-schema describe(), are the next P2 waves. Backfill the Core commit, the builder-and-checklist collapse diff, the plan-tool type-check result, and a proof that the rendered guidance now states the >=3 floor and the real verb allowlist (guidance==gate).
